title: Manual Cell Counting of FISH-Labeled Cells
author: Sylvie Dumas

steps.title: Configure software parameters
steps.instruction: Set the intensity, luminosity, and contrast parameters in the NDP.view2 and QuPath software for each probe pair.

steps.title: Identify and count cells
steps.instruction: Manually count cells by defining each cell with a circle outline based on the DAPI nuclear staining and the FISH-generated fluorescent signal.

substeps.instruction: Use DAPI nuclear staining to distinguish between cells located close to each other
Check fluorescent signals channel by channel for each selected cell
Analyze and collect counts for high and low expression of each probe
